title: Mantras for every planet: the navagraha beej mantras | Ask Tota
description: The beej mantra for each of the nine grahas, the day and deity linked to each, traditional japa counts, and how to start a simple practice for free.
og_description: Nine planets, nine beej mantras, nine days and deities. The most accessible remedy in Vedic astrology, explained simply and honestly.
h1: a mantra for every planet: the nine beej mantras and how to actually use them
dek: of all the remedies in vedic astrology, mantras are the cheapest, the safest and the oldest. each of the nine grahas has a short seed mantra, a day of the week and a deity. here are all nine, with the traditional counts, and a simple way to start.

llms_desc: the beej (seed) mantra for each of the nine Vedic grahas, the weekday and deity traditionally associated with each, commonly cited japa counts, the general Navagraha shloka, how to begin a simple mantra practice, and how mantras compare with other remedies.

faq.a: a seed mantra: a short sacred syllable or set of syllables associated with a deity or planet. each graha's beej mantra combines a seed syllable with the planet's name, for example om hraam hreem hraum sah suryaya namah for the sun.

faq.q: what is the surya beej mantra?
faq.a: om hraam hreem hraum sah suryaya namah. it is traditionally recited on sundays, ideally at sunrise.

faq.q: what is the shani beej mantra?
faq.a: om praam preem praum sah shanaischaraya namah. it is traditionally recited on saturdays.

faq.q: what is the chandra beej mantra?
faq.a: om shraam shreem shraum sah chandraya namah, traditionally recited on mondays.

faq.q: how many times should i chant a planet mantra?
faq.a: for daily practice, 108 times on a mala is the traditional unit. commonly cited full japa counts, such as 23,000 for saturn or 7,000 for the sun, are spread over many days. consistency matters more than volume.

faq.q: which day is for which planet?
faq.a: sunday sun, monday moon, tuesday mars, wednesday mercury, thursday jupiter, friday venus, saturday saturn. rahu is usually propitiated on saturday and ketu on tuesday or saturday.

faq.q: which planet mantra should i chant?
faq.a: astrologers usually suggest the mantra of ur current dasha lord, ur lagna lord, or a weak but important planet in ur chart. if unsure, the general navagraha shloka covers all nine.

yes. mantra japa is generally considered open to anyone and, unlike gemstones, is not traditionally considered risky. correct pronunciation and a sincere, regular practice are what traditions emphasise.

faq.q: do i need a guru to chant beej mantras?
faq.a: some traditions say beej mantras are most effective when received from a teacher. many people chant them without formal initiation. the general navagraha shloka and simple name mantras are widely chanted by everyone.

a short prayer to all nine planets: brahma murari tripurantakari bhanuh shashi bhumisuto budhashcha, gurushcha shukrah shani rahu ketavah sarve grahah shanti kara bhavantu. it asks all nine grahas to bring peace.

there is no scientific evidence that mantras change planetary influences. there is research suggesting repetitive mantra or meditation practice can reduce stress for some people. many value it as devotion and discipline.
traditionally mantras are considered safe for everyone and free, while gemstones are prescribed cautiously. if u are choosing a remedy, mantras are the gentlest place to start.
